title.zh: MiniMax H3 视频专线新增 5 个场景分组
title.en: MiniMax H3 video line adds five scenario groups

summary.zh: `minimax-h3-video` 保持单一公开 ID，新增数字人口播、短剧分镜、短剧音画、文生创意、首尾帧 5 个场景分组；通过 `X-Omnimux-Group` 选择，不新增模型 ID，分组倍率均为 1.0×。
summary.en: `minimax-h3-video` keeps its single public ID and adds five scenario groups: digital human, short drama, short drama with audio, creative text-to-video, and first-last frame. Select them with `X-Omnimux-Group`; no new model IDs, all at 1.0×.

body.zh:
## 场景分组

`minimax-h3-video` 的公开 ID 不变，新增 5 个按用途划分的请求级分组：

| 场景 | 分组 | 输入要求 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 数字人口播 | `minimax-h3-video-digital-human` | 人像图 + 口播音频，不带 `prompt` |
| 短剧分镜 | `minimax-h3-video-short-drama` | 多张参考图，`prompt` 必填 |
| 短剧音画 | `minimax-h3-video-short-drama-av` | 多图 + 多段音频，`prompt` 必填 |
| 文生创意 | `minimax-h3-video-creative` | 仅 `prompt` |
| 首尾帧 | `minimax-h3-video-first-last-frame` | `first_frame` + `last_frame`，`prompt` 必填 |

## 选择方式

- 接口路径不变：`POST /v1/videos`，`GET /v1/videos/{task_id}`
- 用请求头 `X-Omnimux-Group` 选择分组；`/v1/videos` 不解析 `model@group` 后缀
- 所有场景分组倍率为 1.0×，不进入 `auto` 轮询；不指定分组时仍走 `default` 自动分流

## 文档

- [MiniMax H3 视频专线](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
body.en:
## Scenario groups

The public `minimax-h3-video` ID is unchanged. Five request-scoped groups are now available by use case:

| Scenario | Group | Input requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Digital human | `minimax-h3-video-digital-human` | Portrait image + speech audio, no `prompt` |
| Short drama | `minimax-h3-video-short-drama` | Multiple reference images, `prompt` required |
| Short drama with audio | `minimax-h3-video-short-drama-av` | Multiple images + audio clips, `prompt` required |
| Creative text-to-video | `minimax-h3-video-creative` | `prompt` only |
| First-last frame | `minimax-h3-video-first-last-frame` | `first_frame` + `last_frame`, `prompt` required |

## Selection

- Paths are unchanged: `POST /v1/videos`, `GET /v1/videos/{task_id}`
- Select a group with the `X-Omnimux-Group` header; `/v1/videos` does not parse a `model@group` suffix
- All scenario groups are 1.0×, are not part of `auto` rotation, and the `default` automatic path remains when no group is specified

## Documentation

- [MiniMax H3 video line](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
